- PC submissions **must** use and display the integrated timer in LiveSplit, with **Compare Against** set to **Game Time** ([setup tutorial](https://www.speedrun.com/sekiro/guides/4jhzx)). Console submissions **must** show the final IGT (In-Game Time) on the "Load Game" screen after completion of the run (Mortal Journey Gauntlet console submissions **must** also show IGT before run start).
- Submissions must show selecting "New Game" from the main menu screen at the start of the run (does not apply to Mortal Journey Gauntlet runs).
- Submissions must include in-game audio at all times (game music optional).
- All game modifications (including cosmetic changes) are banned except the mods directly integrated into the Sekiro LiveSplit plugin (fixes IGT and removes startup logos and tutorial popups). **Do not use standalone versions of the integrated mods**, only use them as provided through LiveSplit. Using Borderless Gaming to make Sekiro borderless is also allowed.
- No instance of Cheat Engine or Practice Tool of any kind may be connected to the game upon starting a run. Sekiro must be closed and restarted if any instance has been used.
- If you use the save & quit mechanic at any point during a run, you are required to resume gameplay within 10 seconds when "PRESS ANY BUTTON" appears on screen. (More than 1 second would count as 1 idling instance. More than 10 instances would be considered stalling and cause the run to be rejected.)
- Closing the game in any way (game crash, ALT+F4, quitting from main menu) during a run is banned. It is specifically allowed only when performing a Force Quit Wrong Warp in Unrestricted.
- The usage of macros, turbo buttons, free-scrolling mouse wheels, SOCD (Snap Tap), etc. is banned. Standard mouse scroll wheels are allowed.
- The following UI elements must be visible at all times ([example](https://www.speedrun.com/static/blob/qnyo89ep.png)): 

> Player health, restoration markers, and posture meter; Boss health, deathblow markers, and posture meter; Equipped items, tools, and spirit emblems; Items picked up; XP bar; Autosave icon (top right).

categories.name: All Achievements
categories.rules:
# **Category Rules**

Beat the game and obtain **all 34 achievements/trophies**.

Runs must start from an account with 0 achievements/trophies unlocked. For console runs, this can be achieved by creating a new local account/profile before each run. For PC runs, use Steam Achievement Manager to reset all of your achievements before each run.

Runs must display the achievement/trophy popups that appear whenever an achievement/trophy is obtained. It is allowed for the popups to cover UI elements. It is recommended to disable other notifications, such as steam friend activity, to avoid covering UI unnecessarily. It is highly encouraged to also show the achievement/trophy count before and after the run to verify there are 0 unlocked at the start and all 34 unlocked at the end.

# **Breaks**

- Taking a break, lasting a few minutes, during the end credits when the timer is paused, is allowed.
- Taking a break while the timer is running is allowed at any time.
- For Restricted, taking a break during a quitout is not allowed. The rule about having to resume gameplay within 10s after a quitout is still active.

# **Timing**

The timer starts automatically after starting New Game and stops directly after reaching the credits if an ending is the final achievement unlocked. If a player unlocks a non-ending achievement last, the player has to perform a quitout after the achievement is unlocked and end the timer after quitting out.

categories.name: Mortal Journey Gauntlet
categories.rules:
Complete the **Mortal Journey gauntlet**.

Runs may make any preparations desired before starting the gauntlet and can be performed on any NG/NG+ cycle (gauntlets are not affected by NG+).

Runs must show selecting the Mortal Journey gauntlet from the idol at the start of the run.

# Timing 计时

For PC runs, the timer must be manually started during the initial load screen after selecting the Mortal Journey gauntlet and stopped during the final load screen after exiting the gauntlet.

For console runs, the IGT on the "Load Game" screen must be shown before loading the game save and must quitout and show the IGT again after exiting the gauntlet. The difference between these two is the final time.

- Exploiting enemy AI with stunlocks, dead-angling etc.
- Stealth deathblow on Fake Corrupted Monk in Mibu Village.
- 迷雾贵人树杈上房子和道场上天守阁
